enchantments.tooltip: Ram's Might: You permanently benefit from the spell Ram's Might.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Quality Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Strength.
Constitution +13: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
